decisions.reason: The offshore vessel management service was launched with a publicly announced new business unit and fits the firm's expansion into broader maritime services, so management would stay committed despite mixed later visibility.

Crew and corporate travel management is very close to the core offer, and any disappointing recent results can plausibly be attributed to temporary travel disruption rather than a flawed strategic move.

The online vessel information portal shows weaker visible commitment and is less central to the firm's service-and-operations identity, so management has less reason to escalate and can redeploy those lighter digital resources.

The mobile vessel performance app supports the firm's stated aim of safer, cleaner and more sustainable shipping, which makes management inclined to persist with it even if uptake has been slower than expected.
